thread:
Nina (PM): Need a small, auditable rollout plan for routing-v2 that supports tenant opt-in, kill-ladder, and a short A/B cost experiment. Can we capture cohorts + hard gates?
Carlos (Eng): Proposal: cohorts = [internal, finserv-beta (whitelist), rand-50-tenants]. Ramp by tenants not percent for safety. Hold windows: 30m for internal, 3h for beta, 6h for rand-50.
Yuri (SRE): Gates (auto-rollback): p95 > baseline*1.3 for 10m OR error-rate > 0.2% for 5m OR eval-quality boolean flips. Have per-AZ circuit-breaker and global kill flag.
Jules (ProdOps): Flag schema: feat.routing.v2.enabled with per-tenant overrides and a pause button in Console. Add a "notify-cs-on-pause" toggle for FinServ.
Mina (QA): Shadow 48h before any tenant joins beta. Acceptance per step: p95 < baseline*1.15, errors < 0.1%, quality-delta <= 1%.
Carlos (Eng): Fallback ladder: routing-v2 -> routing-v2-8q -> routing-v1. For the A/B: 20 tenants in rand-50 split 50/50 v2-full vs v2-8q, measure cost/1k and quality_score.
release-bot: [automation] Will post roll progress and execute routing.v2.kill on gate breach; creates incident stub.
Nina (PM): OK, I'll add these into the PRD rollout section and assign owners: Carlos (flags+kills), Yuri (dashboards+alerts), Jules (console+runbook), Mina (shadow tests). Kickoff staging dry-run next Wed.
